newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian crude weaker, May Tapis done at OSP +20/25.
newsitem.headline: Asian crude weaker, May Tapis done at OSP +20/25.

text.p: Asian crude prices weakened further on Monday, with values under pressure from an overhand of crudes.
Petron tendered to buy Qatar Marine or Lower Zakum for May loading, but was unlikely to receive offers as low as recent spot deals, traders said. The tender closes today and is valid overnight.
May Qatar Marine has already been placed and it would take term barrels to meet the Petron tender. Upper Zakum rarely appears on the spot market.

Traders said they expected the Tapis premium, assessed at 50 to 70 cents, to come under pressure because of its wide spread against Brent of more than $3.00. A producer last sold a top-up cargo of early May Tapis at OSP +20/+25 cents to a trader.

Minas and Duri were valued around flat to the ICP after deals at that level into China last week. Minas and Duri mostly traded for April loading at ICP -20/-10 cents but firmed last week as affiliates held off remaining barrels in what was perceived a more balanced market.
Traders said the focus was shifting now to May liftings, but ahead of the monthly export allocations, there were no serious price offers.
The May/June Dubai spread was assessed around -45 cents, supporting the May Brent/Dubai out at $1.70/$1.85 from -15 cents and $1.70/$1.80 in New York on Friday.
Traders said one or two cargoes could still be available, with spreads indicating a spot differential of full month quotes less 45 cents.
